name: todo-list-app
description: Interactive vanilla JavaScript Todo List with local storage, search, and filtering.

paragraphs: A modern, responsive, offline-first task management web application built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, modern CSS3, and Firebase Firestore. Syncs seamlessly in real-time across multiple devices with Google Authentication, and operates with zero disruption offline via a dedicated Service Worker and localStorage caching.
features: Real-time document updates via Firebase Firestore (onSnapshot).
Check off or create a task on your phone, and see it reflect on your desktop within milliseconds without refreshing.
PWA Service Worker (sw.js): Caches all core assets (HTML, CSS, JS, manifest, and icons) and Google CDN scripts for instant loading even in Airplane mode.
Instant Local Execution: App boots synchronously from localStorage in milliseconds with zero network blocking.
Optimistic UI Updates: All task operations (create, check off, edit, delete) update the DOM and localStorage immediately.

requirements.text: Secure, one-click Google Sign-In with profile avatar and display name.
Seamless guest mode: works out-of-the-box using local storage without requiring login.
